calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for UNISPORT A/S
calls.summary: The team discussed the evaluation of GrowthBook's enterprise plans, focusing on the cost, implementation, and compliance implications of self-hosted and cloud-hosted options. Self-hosting is approximately $10,000 cheaper annually but requires managing AWS infrastructure, while cloud hosting offers ease of setup with higher costs. Compliance with GDPR was addressed, emphasizing that GrowthBook does not retain personal data externally and minimizes risks related to A/B testing. Unisport anticipates running about 5 experiments per month, with pricing based on the number of experiments and the added platform fee of $50,000 for enterprise features. A follow-up meeting with GrowthBook's engineer, Logan, was planned to refine the implementation details and address technical needs.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Self Hosting, Enterprise Plan, Data Warehouse, Experimentation Platform
